reason: The company is subject to a mandatory unconditional cash offer, indicating a takeover event.
why_now: The announcement of the completion of the sale and purchase agreement and the mandatory offer is effective immediately.
source_headlines: MAJOR HLDGS (01389): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT (1) THE SALE AND PURCHASE OF THE SHARES IN MAJOR HOLDINGS LIMITED; (2) COMPLETION OF THE SALE AND PURCHASE AGREEMENT; (3) MANDATORY UNCONDITIONAL CASH OFFER BY KINGSTON SECURITIES LIMITED FOR AND ON BEHALF OF MAX PREMIER LIMITED TO ACQUIRE ALL THE ISSUED SHARES OF MAJOR HOLDINGS LIMITED (OTHER THAN THOSE ALREADY OWNED AND/OR AGREED TO BE ACQUIRED BY MAX PREMIER LIMITED AND PARTIES ACTING IN CONCERT WITH IT); AND (4) RESUMPTION OF TRADIN
